blocks.text: Special terms and conditions for packages

blocks.html: This is a structural placeholder for the mockup. The final wording must come from EC Assets' legal counsel before publication.
These special terms apply in addition to the general terms whenever you order a package such as the {{product}}.
A package bundles several products at a combined price. The contents are listed on the product page at the time of ordering.
Extras such as the digital student ID, travel health insurance and the insurance bonus tariff are provided by partners and are subject to their conditions and availability.
If you remove a product from the package, the package price no longer applies and the individual prices are charged.
